'''''Star Wars''''' is a [[canon]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series that takes place between [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Episode VII: The Force Awakens'']], and was written by [[Alex Segura]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]]. It is set after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Battle of Jakku]]''. The [[Star Wars (2025) 1|first issue]] was published on [[May 7]], [[2025]].
